description: This PHP class defines parameters for deleting a module in the API V8 of the project, including methods to retrieve module name and ID, and configuring parameter options.

classes.name: DeleteModuleParams
classes.description: A class that manages delete module parameters, providing accessors for module name and ID, and method to configure parameter options.

methods.name: getModuleName
methods.description: Returns the name of the module to be deleted.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the module to be deleted.

methods.name: configureParameters
methods.description: Configures the resolver with expected parameter options for deletion.
